name: Soothing Hymn
body:
Requirement: Perform 15 ranks

Base effect: All allies within 30 feet gain fast healing 5.

Refrain

You channel positive energy in the bodies of your allies, closing their wounds. Using this refrain requires a full-round action.

Weak Refrain: all allies within 30 feet recover 1d4 points of damage per siren level (max 10d4).

Intermediate Refrain: all allies within 30 feet recover 1d6 points of damage per siren level (max 15d6).

Strong refrain: all allies within 30 feet recover 1d8 points of damage per siren level (max 20d8).
